mapper.sql: p.id, p.package_no, p.store_id, p.warehouse_id, p.channel_id, p.carrier, p.carrier_name, p.carrier_order_no, p.tracking_no, p.label_time, p.print_count, p.weight, p.shipping_cost, p.status, p.ship_time, p.ship_name, p.ship_country, p.error_msg, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_time, CASE WHEN p.label_file IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_label, s.name AS store_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, ch.name AS channel_name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pi.order_id) FROM ecom_package_item pi WHERE pi.package_id = p.id) AS order_count, (SELECT SUM(pi.qty) FROM ecom_package_item pi WHERE pi.package_id = p.id) AS total_qty
FROM ecom_package p JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = p.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = p.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ecom_logistics_channel ch ON ch.id = p.channel_id

sql.if: AND (p.package_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.ship_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_package_item pi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = pi.order_id WHERE pi.package_id = p.id AND o.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')))

mapper.select:
SELECT p.status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM ecom_package p
GROUP BY p.status

SELECT
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_package_item pi WHERE pi.package_id = p.id AND pi.order_id = #{orderId}) ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.* FROM ecom_package p WHERE (p.tracking_no = #{code} OR p.package_no = #{code}) AND p.status <> 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY p.id DESC
SELECT p.* FROM ecom_package p WHERE p.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT st.material_id AS "materialId", l.code AS "locationCode", l.zone AS "zone", l.sort AS "sort", st.qty - st.frozen_qty AS "qty" FROM wms_stock st LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = st.location_id WHERE st.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND st.qty - st.frozen_qty > 0 AND st.material_id IN #{m} ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, l.zone, l.sort, l.code
